name: Validating whether new location is created.
description: Validating new location is created as Zee Building, Mumbai, India.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM location
WHERE name = 'Zee Building'
  AND city = 'mumbai'
  AND country = 'india';

name: Validating new user creation.
description: Validating whether new active admin user Abraham George is created with location details.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user u
JOIN location l ON u.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Abraham'
  AND u.last_name = 'George'
  AND u.email = 'abraham.george@servicenow.com'
  AND u.role = 'admin'
  AND u.active = 1
  AND l.name = 'Zee Building'
  AND l.city = 'mumbai'
  AND l.country = 'india';

name: Validating user removal from group.
description: Validating whether Kurt Fritz is removed from Contact Center L2 group.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Kurt'
  AND u.last_name = 'Fritz'
  AND g.name = 'Contact Center L2';

name: Validating user deactivation.
description: Validating whether Kurt Fritz is deactivated.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user
WHERE first_name = 'Kurt'
  AND last_name = 'Fritz'
  AND active = 0;

name: Validating new group member addition.
description: Validating whether Abraham George and Aaron Le are added to Contact Center L2.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE g.name = 'Contact Center L2'
  AND (
        (u.first_name = 'Abraham' AND u.last_name = 'George')
     OR (u.first_name = 'Aaron' AND u.last_name = 'Le')
      );

name: Validating user removal from other groups.
description: Validating Aaron Le is removed from all other groups except Contact Center L2.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Aaron'
  AND u.last_name = 'Le'
  AND g.name <> 'Contact Center L2';
